dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge with a smooth falcate spline curve from the dorsal insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex morphology with a medium-sized pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree upward slope relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 1.6:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Uniformly convex arc with a consistent radius along the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short rostrum with a roughly 1:1 ratio of visible length to thickness from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan/teal monochromatic color cast across the entire subject; distinct visibility of the right pectoral fin and horizontal caudal flukes.
